title: atomate2 VASP elastic tensor
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk atomate2-elastic workflow: it runs atomate2's ElasticMaker, a VASP relaxation, then relaxations of strained cells, and a fit of the elastic tensor to their stresses. The protocol, the VASP input sets and the custodian error handling are those of atomate2's ElasticMaker.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure whose elastic tensor is computed.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the relaxed structure that was strained, output role elastic_tensor is a records entry containing the fitted elastic stiffness tensor in Voigt form, in GPa, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure, output role compliance_tensor is a records entry containing the elastic compliance tensor in Voigt form, in GPa^-1, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure, output role bulk_modulus_voigt is a records entry containing the Voigt bulk modulus, in GPa, output role bulk_modulus_reuss is a records entry containing the Reuss bulk modulus, in GPa, output role bulk_modulus_hill is a records entry containing the Hill bulk modulus, in GPa, output role shear_modulus_voigt is a records entry containing the Voigt shear modulus, in GPa, output role shear_modulus_reuss is a records entry containing the Reuss shear modulus, in GPa, output role shear_modulus_hill is a records entry containing the Hill shear modulus, in GPa, output role universal_anisotropy_index is a records entry containing the universal elastic anisotropy index, and output role task_document is a files entry containing jobflow-outputs.json: the flow's final output (atomate2 task documents) as JSON.

inputs.name: initial_structure
inputs.description: The structure whose elastic tensor is computed.

outputs.name: relaxed_structure
outputs.description: The relaxed structure that was strained.

outputs.name: elastic_tensor
outputs.description: The fitted elastic stiffness tensor in Voigt form, in GPa, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure.

outputs.name: compliance_tensor
outputs.description: The elastic compliance tensor in Voigt form, in GPa^-1, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus_voigt
outputs.description: The Voigt bulk modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus_reuss
outputs.description: The Reuss bulk modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus_hill
outputs.description: The Hill bulk modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: shear_modulus_voigt
outputs.description: The Voigt shear modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: shear_modulus_reuss
outputs.description: The Reuss shear modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: shear_modulus_hill
outputs.description: The Hill shear modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: task_document
outputs.description: jobflow-outputs.json: the flow's final output (atomate2 task documents) as JSON.
